summary: Republic Power Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on August 24, 2026. Shareholders approved amendments to increase authorized shares from unlimited to 11 billion, change the authorized share clause, increase Class B voting power from 30 to 100 votes per share, adopt a fifth amended memorandum and articles, and authorize share consolidations. Voting tallies are provided. This is routine corporate governance housekeeping, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other event category applies. The filing is a standard EGM results report under Form 6-K.
